parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle part of the switch made of durable plastic, typically rectangular and protruding from the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that allows the user to turn the electrical circuit on or off by flipping or pressing it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally around a small axis to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the switch, made of insulating plastic, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism and provides a surface for mounting onto a wall or electrical box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
